name: get_server_info
title: Get server info
description: Return the narumi server identity, version, capabilities and diagnostics. `capabilities` reports whether recording can be attempted on this machine (narumi-recorder binary present and microphone permission not known to be denied; `permissions` gives the state from `narumi-recorder check`), permission_setup_in_progress, the active transports, and registry names of installed engines, providers and exporters. `recording` and `permissions` use the same permission snapshot. Set refresh_permissions=true to bypass the short permission cache after returning from macOS settings; while a permission action is in progress, the current cached report may be returned instead and permission_setup_in_progress remains true. This read-only tool never triggers a permission prompt. `diagnostics` reports resolved ffmpeg / ffprobe binaries, data and meetings roots, catalog path, recorder path and loaded contracts directory. Call with empty arguments first to detect the contract version. Contract major 5 adds explicit API transcription selection. The minutes_model_providers and transcription_model_providers capability arrays report implemented generation paths separately from connection readiness. transcription_model_providers is [openai-api] only for the resident streamable-http server and [] for other transports; ensemble generation remains unavailable. secure_transport describes required protection, never trusted bootstrap pins or tokens. On failure returns an error_envelope (isError=true) with code: internal.

inputSchema.description: Optional permission cache refresh; empty arguments preserve the existing read-only probe.

refresh_permissions.description: Recheck OS permission state instead of using the short cache, unless a permission action is still running. Never requests permission.

server_instance_id.description: Random UUID fixed for the lifetime of this running server context; changes after a restart. Permission setup clients must bind unresolved actions to this identity and accept idle reconciliation only from the same instance. Missing in older servers; absence or a different instance is not proof that an earlier helper exited. This is an identity marker, not a secret or authentication credential.

contract_version.description: Semantic version of the tool contracts this server implements (contracts/manifest.json).

secure_transport.description: Required transport capabilities, not a source of trusted pins or authentication tokens. Network clients verify the owner-only bootstrap and TLS pin before trusting any server response.

workflow.description: Implemented workflow operations, independent of connection readiness. Supported text minutes and API transcription paths are listed separately; ensemble and general all-stage selection are unavailable.

recording.description: True when start_recording can be attempted: narumi-recorder found, its permission check succeeded and microphone access is not denied. Screen recording is not part of this flag because its denied status also covers never requested; see permissions for the raw state. configure_recording_permission lets clients request access explicitly before starting a recording.

permission_setup_in_progress.description: True while an explicit permission action or its owned-child cleanup is running. Do not start recording or restart/update the app until it becomes false. Omitted by older servers.

transcription_engines.description: Registry names usable as transcription_engine (e.g. auto, fake, mlx-whisper, faster-whisper).

diarization_engines.description: Registry names usable as diarization_engine (e.g. none, fake, pyannote).

llm_providers.description: Registry names usable as llm_provider (e.g. none, fake, claude-agent-sdk, anthropic-api, ollama).

minutes_model_providers.description: Adapters implemented for explicit text-only minutes_model selection, independent of whether a connection is authenticated, prepared or has available models. An empty array means this server cannot execute explicit minutes models. Claude Agent SDK generation is excluded. UI and CLI must also validate connection, catalog and policy before selection or generation.

export_destinations.description: Registry names accepted by export_minutes.destination (e.g. markdown, html).

transcription_model_providers.description: Implemented API transcription paths, independent of connection authentication and model readiness. The resident streamable-http server advertises [openai-api]; other execution modes advertise []. Clients must also check connection revision, API authentication, timestamp capability, expiry and api_ok.

diagnostics.description: Local environment diagnostics. Binary entries are null when the binary was not found.

ffmpeg.description: Resolved ffmpeg binary, or null when not found (preprocessing is then unavailable).

ffprobe.description: Resolved ffprobe binary, or null when not found.

meetings_root.description: Absolute path of the directory holding the session bundles (<NARUMI_HOME>/meetings).

catalog_path.description: Absolute path of the catalog database (narumi.db).

recorder_path.description: Absolute path of the narumi-recorder binary, or null when not found (recording is then unavailable).

contracts_dir.description: Absolute path of the contracts directory the server loaded.
